verses.6: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

verses.12: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
verses.13: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
verses.14: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
verses.15: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
